title: Web Search
subtitle: Choose the service your Agent uses to find information on the web.

providerDescriptions.exaMcpFree: No API key or extra configuration needed
providerDescriptions.exaSearchApi: Requires an Exa API key; enter and save it below
providerDescriptions.tavily: Requires a Tavily API key; enter and save it below
providerDescriptions.openbitfunSearchHttp: Connect a self-hosted or internal search service with its address and required authentication

provider.title: Search provider
provider.description: Search is configured separately from chat models; the service determines which address and credentials are needed

http.title: Custom search service
http.description: The service must implement OpenBitFun Search HTTP Protocol v1

protocol.title: Protocol specification
protocol.description: The request and response format required for a custom search endpoint.

credential.title: Search service credentials
credential.description: Keys are encrypted on the host that runs searches and are not synced to other devices

provider.label: Provider
provider.description: Used for subsequent web searches after saving

providerHelp.label: Setup requirements
providerHelp.description: Choose a search service to see its setup requirements.

endpoint.label: Service URL
endpoint.description: HTTPS is required. Plain HTTP is accepted only for localhost or a loopback IP.

headerName.label: Credential header name
headerName.description: Enter a custom header such as X-API-Key; choose Bearer credentials for Authorization

credential.label: API key or secret
credential.description: Saving a new value replaces this service's key on the execution host
credential.replacePlaceholder: Enter a new credential to replace the saved value

status.missing: Credentials missing on the execution host

request.title: Request
request.description: The endpoint must accept this POST request. query must be a non-empty string, and maxResults must be an integer from 1 to 20.

success.title: Success response
success.description: A 2xx response must use application/json or the v1 media type. title and url are required; publishedAt and author may be omitted or null.

error.title: Error response
error.description: A non-2xx response may use this shape. OpenBitFun also maps common errors from the HTTP status when the envelope is absent.

notes.resultHandling: The service may return fewer than maxResults results. OpenBitFun validates, deduplicates, and truncates results, and ignores unknown response-root fields.
notes.transportLimits: OpenBitFun does not follow redirects. Requests time out after 60 seconds, and response bodies are limited to 1 MiB.

messages.loadFailed: Failed to load Web Search settings.
messages.saveFailed: Failed to save Web Search configuration.
messages.credentialSaved: Credentials saved on the execution host
messages.credentialSaveFailed: Failed to save credentials on the execution host
messages.credentialSaveFailedAfterConfigSaved: Search configuration saved, but credentials could not be saved on the execution host. Enter the credentials again and retry
messages.credentialCleared: Credentials cleared from the execution host
messages.credentialClearFailed: Failed to clear credentials from the execution host
